sentences.text: Uberabatitan represents the most recent titanosaur discovered within the Bauru Group's specific geological clade and location.
Fossil evidence indicates this species survived in an environment defined by extreme heat and aridity.
Remains were uncovered in the uppermost layers of the Maastrichtian-age Serra da Galga Formation near Uberaba, Minas Gerais.
The species name honors Luiz Carlos Borges Ribeiro, the director of the Centro de Pesquisas Paleontológicas Lewellyn Price, for his support.
Like other sauropods, Uberabatitan experienced rapid, uninterrupted growth during its early life stages.
This animal lived during the Late Cretaceous, specifically within the Maastrichtian period spanning from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
